description: Power monitoring devices for panel mounting: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, THD, frequency, min/max, demand, tariff energies, status bits, digital I/O and settings
source: Siemens, SENTRON Power Monitoring Device 7KM PAC3120 and PAC3220, Equipment Manual 10/2019, L1V30425208F-01, appendix A (Modbus)
notes: Modbus RTU over RS485 on both models; the PAC3220 also has Modbus TCP over Ethernet (port 502). Factory RTU settings: address 126, 19200 baud, 8N2.

Addresses are the manual's offsets, which are the addresses sent on the wire. Values are read with function 03 or 04, settings written with 16 and commands with 06; the status bits are discrete inputs read with function 02.
Read every value from its first register with its full length: a read that starts or ends inside a multi-register value returns an error.
Not in this map: the bit structure of the status and diagnostics words (offsets 203-209), the I&M data, the load profile and history files (FC20) and the device identification (FC43).
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
